title: Create a Project for an existing Client
outcome: From the target Project directory, create one Project for a represented active existing Client with exact optional category allocations, accept it durably while offline, and expose its pending or rejected state without losing the draft.

uiJourneys.sourcePage: ProjectsListView, NewProjectView, and shared form/list controls
uiJourneys.targetPage: Target Project directory and existing-Client New Project sheet

controls.label: Add Project
controls.action: Open Project creation from the active Project directory.

controls.label: Step 1 — Basic information

options.label: Project name *
options.result: Accepts an ordinary nonblank Project display name; the unresolved cross-runtime boundary remains a cutover blocker.

options.label: Existing Client *
options.result: Selects one represented active Client by stable ID, replacing free-text ownership.

options.label: Description
options.result: Accepts optional multiline Project description with existing target trimming semantics.

options.label: Next / Cancel
options.result: Next requires valid represented inputs; Cancel dismisses without accepting an operation.

controls.action: Enter Project identity and choose its existing Client.
controls.result: Advances without losing the draft only when the represented selection is valid.

controls.label: Step 2 — Select budget categories

options.label: Category row
options.result: Selects or deselects a represented configurable category by stable ID.

options.label: Next / Back
options.result: Moves between category selection and amounts while retaining the draft.

options.label: Add Category
options.result: Deferred pending O-026; it is not exposed by this workflow.

controls.action: Choose at least one currently represented category.
controls.result: Preserves the exact selected category identities for allocation entry.

controls.label: Step 3 — Set budget amounts

options.label: Category amount
options.result: Preserves blank as unset, explicit zero as zero, and a valid positive currency amount exactly.

options.label: Create Project / Back
options.result: Back retains the draft; Create performs one durable atomic Project setup operation.

controls.action: Enter optional allocations and submit while online or offline.
controls.result: The sheet reports local acceptance, pending state, or recoverable rejection without duplicate submission.

transitions.to: Pending Project represented by stable ID and operation status

states.name: Reference data loading, partial, stale, empty, or failed
states.expected: Client and category readiness is visible; incomplete evidence never becomes an authoritative empty or an invented selection.

states.name: Invalid or disappeared selection
states.expected: Forward navigation and submission fail closed while typed input remains available.

states.name: Offline accepted
states.expected: One durable receipt is visible immediately and survives encrypted restart and deterministic replay.

states.name: Submission rejected or ambiguous
states.expected: The draft remains, a diagnostic is visible, and retry reuses the same Project and Operation identities when acceptance was ambiguous.

states.name: Deferred source controls
states.expected: New-Client creation, inline category creation, notes, and hero media are absent and remain explicitly tracked rather than silently dropped.

acceptanceChecks.expected: The target three-step existing-Client flow requires at least one category and accepts one Project with exact selected categories and allocations.

Executable AppModel tests prove step navigation, validation, draft retention, readiness, and pending/failure behavior; compiled SwiftUI source checks prove the recorded controls, stable identifiers, and action bindings are present. Device interaction and assistive-technology semantics are not claimed by this check.
Offline acceptance, encrypted restart, stable retry identity, replay, rejection, and authoritative readback remain proven.
Only the exact authorized Account and active represented Client/category evidence can create the Project.
The local runtime and operation watch reject cross-Account, cross-Principal, cross-family, mismatched-envelope, and mismatched-fingerprint evidence.
Unset, zero, and positive category allocations remain distinct and the Project setup transaction is atomic.
The pending Project and categories appear only in the exact Account workspace and converge on qualifying authoritative readback.
Relational identities and category references remain valid across all accepted Project setup rows.
Exact replay returns the immutable prior result and conflicting replay is rejected without partial mutation.
App and MCP encode the same typed Project setup command and exact nullable allocations.

deferredBehaviors: O-049 prevents cutover-ready cross-runtime validation for adversarial Project display names; this workflow is limited to ordinary valid names.
O-043 keeps the new-Client branch out of this workflow.
O-026 keeps inline category creation out of this workflow and leaves the current project-budget capability check provisional rather than cutover-authorized.
Hero attachment chaining is a separate durable media workflow; it is not silently implemented or discarded here.
Project notes require a separate operation and O-039 parity; they are not smuggled into Project setup.

End-to-end simulator interaction and assistive-technology semantics remain part of the release UI-validation batch; this workflow proves AppModel behavior plus compiled SwiftUI control/action wiring only.
blockers: O-026 must be approved before this workflow can become cutover-ready because final Project-budget command authorization, RLS, and Sync policy are not yet product-authoritative. The current can_manage_project_budgets check is a provisional implementation for local validation only.

review.summary: Independent review initially found five material correctness/evidence issues and then three additional P2 boundary and UI-honesty issues. Root corrected category and currency requirements, immutable accepted payloads, operation observation and lifecycle coverage, O-026 blocker honesty, Core-only command derivation, proof wording, post-acceptance status presentation, and the direct-command architecture guard. Final re-review returned GO with no remaining P0-P3 finding.
